sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: They Are Already Here is a story chapter in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
Pick up and read Note about the Eye of the World from one of the following locations:
- In the "marked room" at the three-story dorms on Customs

- In the "marked rooms" RB-BK, RB-VO and RB-PKPM on Reserve

- At the marked circle in the dilapidated village in the north of Woods

- In the house on the island on Shoreline

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Learn more about the hooded men/Learn more about the people leaving strange symbols in Tarkov
- Locate a place connected to the Eye of the World
- Learn more about the cultist's victim from the torture room
- Locate the cult victim's apartment
  - (Optional) Obtain the key to the apartment
- Investigate the victim's apartment
- Obtain the victim's first audio tape
- Obtain and read the book that the cultists planted with Igor
- Ask Mechanic about the Eye of the World
  - (Optional) Gain access to Mechanic
- Locate and neutralize a Cultist priest
- Obtain more information about the Eye of the World
- Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Lighthouse
- Investigate the ransacked cultist room in the chalet
  - (Optional) Locate the victim's belongings
- Locate and obtain the key mentioned in the victim's note
- Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Woods
- Investigate the cultists' house marked with the Eye of the World
- Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Shoreline
- Investigate the area around the Sordi communications tower
- Repair the Sordi tower
- Restore Arshavin's keycard
- Gain access to NGO Cobalt's secret facility
- Restore power at the station
- Turn on the cooling system in the server room
- Install a flash drive to download the data
- Investigate ARRS Station 14-4 KORD thoroughly
- Survive and extract from Interchange
- Find a way to disconnect the station from external agents
- Restore the ARRS station to backup settings
  - (Optional) Check that the station power is turned on
- Collect the flash drive from the ARRS station
- Survive and extract from Interchange
- Hand over the flash drive with data to Mechanic
- Read the ARRS station specifications

sections.heading: Learn more about the hooded men/Learn more about the people leaving strange symbols in Tarkov
sections.text: See requirements.

sections.heading: Locate a place connected to the Eye of the World/Learn more about the cultist's victim from the torture room
sections.text:
| Related Quest Items |
| Icon | Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Cult victim audio tape 2 | Cult victim audio tape #2 | 1 | Required | Yes |
To fulfill these objectives, you have to locate the Cultist's torture house on Lighthouse and pick up and listen to the audio tape found there.

The Cult victim's apartment key required for the next objective can also be obtained in the house.

sections.heading: Locate the cult victim's apartment
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Cult victim's apartment key | 1 | Required | N/A |
The wanted apartment is located on the third floor of the old apartment building behind the Klimov shopping mall on Streets of Tarkov. A Cult victim's apartment key is required to enter it.

sections.heading: Investigate the victim's apartment/Obtain the victim's first audio tape and the book the Cultists planted
sections.text:
| Related Quest Items |
| Icon | Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Note on preparations for the Arrival | Note on preparations for the Arrival | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Cult victim audio tape 1 | Cult victim audio tape #1 | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Book of the Arrival | Book of the Arrival | 1 | Required | Yes |
To fulfill these objectives, you have to pick up and read 2 notes as well as pick up and listen to an audio tape from the office inside the apartment. The door has to be breached.

sections.heading: Ask Mechanic about the Eye of the World
sections.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the Eye of the World.

sections.heading: Locate and neutralize a Cultist priest
sections.text: Kill a Cultist priest on any location.

sections.heading: Obtain more information about the Eye of the World
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Dorm room 314 marked key | 1 | Required* | N/A |
| Abandoned factory marked key | 1 | Required* | N/A |
| RB-BK marked key | 1 | Required* | N/A |
| RB-PKPM marked key | 1 | Required* | N/A |
| RB-VO marked key | 1 | Required* | N/A |
| Cultist priest's note | 1 | Required | Yes |
- Only one of the keys is required to complete the objective.

To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read the Cultist priest's note from one of the marked rooms on Customs, Streets of Tarkov or Reserve. Note: The item doesn't spawn before the previous objective is completed.

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: Marked room on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 314 marked key is required to enter it.

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: Marked room on the third floor of the northern abandoned factory building. A Abandoned factory marked key is required to enter it.

sections.heading: RB-BK
sections.text: Marked room on the first floor of the black pawn barrack building. A RB-BK marked key is required to enter it.

sections.heading: RB-PKPM
sections.text: Marked room next to the command office in the underground tunnel system. A RB-PKPM marked key is required to enter it.

sections.heading: RB-VO
sections.text: Marked room in the security barrack building on Reserve. A RB-VO marked key is required to enter it.

sections.heading: Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Lighthouse/Investigate the cultist room in the chalet/Obtain the victim's key
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Victim's note | 1 | Required | Yes |
| Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged) | 1 | Required | Yes |
The wanted place is the small southern bedroom on the second floor of the northern blue chalet on Lighthouse. The Victim's note to pick up and read can be found on the adjacent balcony.

The Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged) is located on an ATV in front of the garage opposite the chalet.

sections.heading: Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Woods
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Newspaper clipping from the cultists' house | 1 | Required | Yes |
The wanted place is a house in the dilapidated village in the north of Woods. The Newspaper clipping from the cultists' house to pick up and read can be found on a whiteboard next to the desk.

sections.heading: Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Shoreline/Investigate the area/Repair the Sordi tower
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Toolset | 1 | Required | N/A | This item is used to repair the Sordi tower. When used, the item is removed from the players' inventory. |
| Programmer's note | 1 | Required | Yes | |
The wanted place is a red metal shack at the radio tower near the "Road to Customs" extraction on Shoreline. The Programmer's note to pick up and read can be found on a dead body next to the tower. To repair the tower, a Toolset has to be used inside the shack.

sections.heading: Learn more about Station 14-4 KORD from Mechanic
sections.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the Eye of the World again.

sections.heading: Restore Arshavin's keycard
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) | 1 | Required | N/A | Has to be crafted in the Hideout (Intelligence center lv. 1). |
Craft the Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted.

sections.heading: Gain access to NGO Cobalt's secret facility
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) | 1 | Required | N/A |
NGO Cobalt's secret facility is located in the basement of the power station on Interchange. A Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) is required to enter it.

sections.heading: Restore power at the station
sections.text: To restore the power you have to swipe the Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) at the keycard panel directly next to the entrance door.

sections.heading: Turn on the cooling system in the server room
sections.text: The server room is located behind the grate door. To turn on the cooling system, flip the lever in the back.

sections.heading: Install a flash drive to download the data
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Secure Flash drive | 1 | Required | N/A | Stashed item |
The Secure Flash drive has to be stashed to the left of the cooling system lever in the server room.

sections.heading: Investigate ARRS Station 14-4 KORD thoroughly
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Mysterious audio tape | 1 | Required | Yes |
To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and listen to the Mysterious audio tape from the safe next to the entrance door. The safe opens automatically after turning on the cooling system.

sections.heading: Survive and extract from Interchange
sections.text: Extract from Interchange with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status.

sections.heading: Find a way to disconnect the station from external agents
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| ARRS station mechanic's notes | 1 | Required | Yes |
Return to the secret facility on Interchange and pick up and read the ARRS station mechanic's notes from the big desk.

sections.heading: Restore the ARRS station to backup settings
sections.text:
Turn on the power again, then go inside the server room and press the button under the table.

Note: Only 1 player per raid can press the button and get progress on this objective. If you can't interact with it, return in a new raid.

sections.heading: Collect the flash drive from the ARRS station
sections.text:
| Completing the previous objective first is required to obtain the major evidence ARRS system specifications! |
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Flash drive for ARRS station | 1 | Handover item | Yes |

Pick up the Flash drive for ARRS station from the server next to the cooling system lever.

sections.heading: Survive and extract from Interchange
sections.text: Extract from Interchange with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status.

sections.heading: Hand over the flash drive with data to Mechanic
sections.text: Hand the Flash drive for ARRS station over to Mechanic through the trader screen.

sections.heading: Read the ARRS station specifications
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| ARRS system specifications | 1 | Required | N/A |
Read the ARRS system specifications from the handbook.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +128,000 EXP
- Unlocks achievement Through Another's Eyes
- Unlocks achievement When the Light Fades
